verdict.rationale: Devin CLI's Adaptive mode is documented as an intelligent model router that analyzes each prompt and automatically sends it to the model expected to give the best result. Users can override it with /model at any time, which preserves human oversight. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the routing works well, documentation that routing extends beyond the CLI to cloud/web sessions, and detail on which models are in the pool or how routing decisions are surfaced.
